crossRefs.note: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”
Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, wrote: Jesus…
The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.
This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose…
and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.
Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with…
They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.

people.name: Galilee
people.line: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry

people.name: Kanah
people.line: Town in Asher's territory; village where Jesus performed miracles

people.name: Nathanael
people.line: Disciple of Jesus, from Cana in Galilee.

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

people.name: Thomas
people.line: One of Jesus' twelve disciples, known for doubting

people.name: Zebedee
people.line: Father of the apostles James and John

translations.web: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.
translations.bsb: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples were together.
translations.kjv: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
translations.asv: There was together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
